verbs.summary: retire a dead ~/work repo: git-bundle all history into ~/work/archive/<year>/, mark hub archived
verbs.hints: Retire a dead ~/work repo to a restorable git bundle. Common mistake: run it on the repo you're still using — it removes the working tree (bundle restores it).

verbs.summary: verify ~/ops is committed + pushed; nag (exit 1) if at risk. Never pushes for you
verbs.hints: Check whether ~/ops is committed + pushed; exit 1 = at risk. Common mistake: expecting it to push — it never transmits, it only nags.

verbs.summary: save a URL as a wiki note (type: bookmark); best-effort title fetch; --archive snapshots to ~/files
verbs.hints: Save a URL as a wiki bookmark note (title fetched best-effort). Common mistake: --archive without a reachable page — the HTML snapshot is skipped.

verbs.summary: thought -> inbox (also: pipe stdin)
verbs.hints: Zero-decision dump of a thought into inbox/ for later triage. Common mistake: using it for an actionable to-do — use `ops task add` instead.

verbs.summary: daily close: summarize the day into the journal, flag loose ends
verbs.hints: Daily close: writes a facts digest (commits, completed, stalled) into the journal. Common mistake: expecting prose — the shell fallback logs facts only.

verbs.summary: nightly dream-lite pass: wiki orphans/stale + day digest into the journal
verbs.hints: Nightly zero-LLM maintenance: wiki orphans/stale + day digest into the journal. Common mistake: scheduling something heavier — this is read + one journal append.

verbs.summary: self-check: tools, folders, manifest, adapters, secrets, index (--init creates folders)
verbs.hints: Self-check: tools, folders, manifest, secrets, sync-wall. --init creates missing folders. Common mistake: ignoring a FAIL (exit 1) — WARN is advisory, FAIL is not.

verbs.summary: binary assets: ingest [<path>] [--client|--project|--area <slug>|--research] | link <file> <hub> | list | open <slug>
verbs.usage: ops files ingest [<path>] [--client|--project|--area <slug> | --research] | link <file> <hub> | list [--hub <slug>] | open <slug>
verbs.hints: The binary-assets plane: ingest routes a file into ~/files + writes a wiki shadow note. Common mistake: expecting the binary in git — only the plaintext shadow note is tracked.

verbs.summary: list verbs / usage for one (rendered from ops.json)
verbs.hints: The surface itself: verbs, capabilities, per-verb I/O contract. Read this first; never invent a verb. Common mistake: hardcoding a verb list instead of reading ops.json.

verbs.summary: rebuild the search index over wiki (FTS5 + graph; +LanceDB if OPS_VECTORS=1); --manifest regenerates ops.json
verbs.hints: Rebuild the FTS5 + graph search index over wiki (+vectors if OPS_VECTORS). Common mistake: searching before indexing — an empty index returns no hits.

verbs.summary: DRAFT an invoice for a client (reads tax-formula.md; computes VAT; never sends)
verbs.hints: DRAFT an invoice (computes VAT); never sends. Common mistake: expecting delivery — you export and send by hand.

verbs.summary: list | run <name> | apply — scheduler-neutral jobs (§15); apply renders launchd plists
verbs.hints: Scheduler-neutral jobs: list/run/apply. Only read/safe_write may be scheduled. Common mistake: a job with inline shell logic — a job calls exactly ONE verb.

verbs.summary: scaffold a project (wiki hub + ~/work repo), client (wiki hub + ~/files tree), or verb (bin/<name>/ stub)
verbs.usage: ops new project "<name>" [--kind labs|products|tools] | new client "<name>" | new verb <name> [--risk <class>] [--summary "<text>"]
verbs.hints: Scaffold a project (wiki hub + ~/work repo), client (hub + ~/files tree), or verb. Common mistake: a slug that collides — slugs are globally unique across the three roots.

verbs.summary: install/list/trust/update/remove plugin packs (untrusted until you trust them)
verbs.usage: ops plugin add <owner/repo|path>[@tag] --yes | list | trust <name> --yes | update <name> --yes | remove <name> --yes
verbs.hints: Installs a pack under plugins/<name>/, but its verbs are capped at confirm until `ops plugin trust <name> --yes` — self-declared risk never takes effect at install. add/update/remove/trust need --yes; list is read-only. Common mistake: expecting a freshly added pack to run at its declared risk.

verbs.summary: ~/work fleet: health | clone <slug>|--all | adopt <path> --kind <k> | nuke-modules --stale <days>
verbs.hints: The ~/work fleet manager: health/clone/adopt/nuke-modules. health exit 1 = repos need attention. Common mistake: adopting into the wrong --kind (products|labs|tools).

verbs.summary: ranked file#heading hits (keyword + graph [+ vectors/rerank])
verbs.hints: Ranked file#heading hits (keyword + graph, +vectors if OPS_VECTORS). Common mistake: running before `ops index`, or too narrow a query — broaden and reindex.

verbs.summary: daily start: today's journal, carry-forward open tasks, dashboard
verbs.hints: Daily start: opens today's journal, carries forward open tasks, shows the dashboard. Common mistake: expecting it to be read-only — it seeds and logs to the journal.

verbs.summary: dashboard: active/waiting tasks, inbox, last index, repo state
verbs.hints: One-screen dashboard: tasks, inbox, index freshness, git state. Read-class. Common mistake: confusing it with `ops start` (which writes the journal).

verbs.summary: decay Desktop/Downloads: untouched 7d → _swept/YYYY-MM/, 60d in _swept → Trash
verbs.hints: Decay Desktop/Downloads: untouched 7d → _swept/, 60d in _swept → Trash (never deletes outright). Common mistake: expecting rescue by reopening — rescue is `ops files ingest`.

verbs.summary: list | add "<title>" | show <id> | move <id> <status> | done <id>
verbs.hints: The task system: list/add/show/move/done. Common mistake: inventing a status — it must be one of inbox/active/waiting/done.

verbs.summary: propose filing of inbox/ items into tasks or wiki; human approves
verbs.hints: Propose filing of inbox/ items into a task or note; the human approves. --json lists proposals without filing. Common mistake: expecting it to auto-file without --yes.

verbs.summary: weekly review: shipped/stalled, repo health, sweep done/ -> done/<year>/
verbs.hints: Weekly review: shipped vs stalled, repo health, sweeps done/ into done/<year>/. Common mistake: running it mid-week expecting it not to sweep — it always sweeps completed tasks.

verbs.summary: open <slug> | edit <slug> | new <type> <name> | backlinks <slug> | stale | orphans | list
verbs.hints: Navigate/grow the wiki: open/edit/new/backlinks/stale/orphans/list. Common mistake: a duplicate slug on `new` — slugs are unique.
